authoritative_rules.canonical_domain: IDs 0-319 are reserved for official abilities/current official slots; 314 and 317 remain reserved gaps rather than Mercury customs.
authoritative_rules.historical_custom_domain: Preserve historical Mercury/ER IDs 320-1042 wherever the same identity or approved redesign still exists.
authoritative_rules.collision_rule: Historical ID 319 Self Sufficient is relocated because official Aura Guard now owns 319.
authoritative_rules.redesign_rule: Approved redesigns inherit the historical slot of the ability they replace when that slot is >=320.
authoritative_rules.new_identity_rule: Mercury identities with no historical slot append from 1043 upward.
authoritative_rules.retired_rule: Superseded semantics are not restored merely to fill an old name.
